task: Create a Spreadsheet object named 'Params' in /home/user/Documents/spreadsheet_start.FCStd. Set cell B1=100 with alias 'length', B2=50 with alias 'width', B3=20 with alias 'height'. Create a Part::Box named 'DrivenBox' and bind its Length, Width, and Height properties to the spreadsheet values via expressions. Save the file.
task_grounding: FreeCAD is open with /home/user/Documents/spreadsheet_start.FCStd (empty document). Create a Spreadsheet named exactly 'Params' (Spreadsheet workbench > New sheet). In 'Params', enter the following values and aliases: cell B1 = 100 with alias 'length'; cell B2 = 50 with alias 'width'; cell B3 = 20 with alias 'height'. (Column A may contain the label text 'length', 'width', 'height' for readability but is not required.) Then switch to the Part workbench, create a Part::Box named exactly 'DrivenBox', and bind its Length, Width, and Height properties to the spreadsheet via expressions: Length = Params.length, Width = Params.width, Height = Params.height (so the box evaluates to 100 x 50 x 20 mm). Save the file with Ctrl+S.
